name: Morning Briefing
description: A daily proactive loop: an is-agent summarizes what changed since yesterday and what needs attention today, delivered to a channel on a cron schedule.

params.name: cron
params.label: Schedule (cron)
params.description: 5-field cron expression controlling when the briefing runs.

params.name: channelId
params.label: Delivery channel
params.description: The channel the briefing is posted into.

playbooks.name: Morning Briefing
playbooks.goalTemplate: Summarize what changed since yesterday and what needs attention today
playbooks.description: Daily summary of recent changes and today's priorities.

triggers.name: Daily morning briefing
triggers.description: Fires the briefing playbook on the configured cron.
